components.name: Actual-image separation as a zero-repair label-erasure test
components.project_addition: Extract an elementary but reusable A2 fast path: a shell label is recoverable after a deterministic retained-coordinate map G exactly when the realized shell images G(W_i) are pairwise disjoint; full tagged-state recovery additionally requires injectivity within every shell. Use this as a zero-repair test before invoking the general P023 future-compatible quotient compiler. The set-theoretic image criterion is not claimed as novel; the project-specific role is its disciplined use in finite-precision theorem lifting and P017 shell-state compression.
